title: Opsis semantic query
description: The query shape sent by the UI, the MCP tools and the assistant. Field references are <table>.<field>: a table of the workspace model, which is the dataset's (or transform's) name, so v1 references keep working. Changes from v1: `dataset` is optional (the compiler picks the base table from the measures), and a filter may be a group of alternatives (`or`), which hierarchy slicers and multi-field selections need.

dataset.description: Base table. Optional: when omitted, the base is the table of the measures, or for a query with no measures the one table every dimension's table is reached from. v1 queries name it, and keep their meaning.

measures.description: Measures may come from more than one table when every grouped dimension reaches each of them; each table's measures are computed apart and joined on the dimensions.

segments.description: Named filters from the model, ANDed with filters.

filters.description: ANDed together. A filter on a field of another table applies through the model's relationships, in their filter direction. Filters on measures become HAVING.

limit.description: Row cap. The server applies its own cap as well (1000 for MCP run_query).

grain.description: Every grain returns the start date of its period. Weeks start on the workspace WEEK_START. Fiscal grains follow FISCAL_YEAR_START_MONTH: fiscal_year and fiscal_quarter are aligned to that month; fiscal_month has the same buckets as month and is labelled as a fiscal period.

range.description: Either a relative range, resolved in the workspace timezone at query time, or absolute dates. Absolute ranges are inclusive of both ends and either end may be omitted (a date slicer's before and after modes).

relative.description: Examples: last_12_months, this_quarter, year_to_date, last_30_days, this_fiscal_year, last_fiscal_year, fiscal_year_to_date. this_<unit> is the whole current period. last_<unit> is the previous complete period. last_N_<units> is N periods ending with the current one. <unit>_to_date runs from the start of the current period to today.

grain.description: When set, the result is grouped by the truncated date. When omitted, range only filters.

filterGroup.description: New in v2. Alternatives: a row passes when every filter of at least one inner list matches. A hierarchy slicer's selection [[VIC, Melbourne], [NSW]] becomes {or: [[state eq VIC, city eq Melbourne], [state eq NSW]]}. Inner filters are on dimensions only.
